subject: Re: POC runway — tiered rebate + usage-swap proposal
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short POC runway extension + pricing flexibility

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the Redwood POC — the platform performance has been great and the engineering team is excited. That said, we hit an unexpected internal scheduling delay: two of our data scientists will be unavailable the next two weeks, which puts our ability to complete the evaluation and produce the final metrics at risk.

Given the timing, we're asking for either a three-week extension to the POC window or a partial credit/rebate that lets us run the remaining tests later without stretching the current timebox. Our procurement team also asked whether a small one-time discount on the milestone invoice would be possible if we commit to a purchase order by the end of July.

Attached is an updated usage forecast so you can see expected token/throughput changes if we extend the window.

Attachments: poc-usage-plan.xlsx (excel)

Can you let me know what flexibility you can offer and what you would need from our side to move fast?

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of ML, BluePeak AI
samir@bluepeak.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@bluepeak.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short POC runway extension + pricing flexibility

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and for the updated forecast. Glad the team is seeing value. I spoke with Ben and we can do one of two pragmatic options to keep the evaluation honest while not creating billing surprises:

Option A — Timebox extension (preferred)
- Add a 3-week extension to the current POC period.
- No change to listed price; instead, we provide a one-time rebate equal to 15% of overage charges incurred during the extension, payable as a credit against the first post-PO invoice.
- Requires a signed amendment and a simple purchase order referencing deal DP-2026-078.

Option B — Usage-swap credits (faster admin)
- Keep the current end date but issue a one-time bucket of credits equal to 30% of the forecasted extension consumption (see your attachment).
- Credits applied to usage over the next 60 days; no amendment required, only written confirmation from procurement.

Operational notes: for Option A we need a short SOW amendment (2 paragraphs) so that onboarding can schedule dedicated slots for your team during the extension period. For Option B we’ll provision credits immediately after written confirmation.

If you want, we can tentatively provision the credits today and switch to Option A if you provide the PO within 10 business days. Which do you prefer?

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead — West Coast Accounts
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short POC runway extension + pricing flexibility

Samir — looping in for pricing confirmation. We can approve Option A with the following guardrails:
- Single one-time rebate of 15% on any overage during the 3-week extension, capped at $12,000.
- Rebate only applied if BluePeak issues a PO referencing DP-2026-078 within 10 business days of amendment signature.
- If BluePeak prefers the credit route (Option B) we can issue credits equal to 30% of forecasted extension usage; credits expire 60 days after grant.

I attached a proposed amendment and a small rebate schedule you can share with procurement. If those look good, Hannah/Laura — please confirm contracting next steps.

Attachments: proposed-amendment-redwood.pdf (PDF), rebate-schedule.csv (CSV)

—Ben

Hi Samir / BluePeak procurement — happy to take this over to finalize contract language. Suggested next steps:

1) Confirm which commercial option you want (Option A — timebox + rebate OR Option B — credits).
2) If Option A, please confirm the PO number you will use and the billing contact; I will upload the two-line amendment to DocuSign and route for signature. Link will be: https://docusign.example.com/BluePeak-POC-Amendment-ID-9981
3) If Option B, please reply with written confirmation from procurement and we will issue the credits; no DocuSign step needed.

A couple of legal notes we added to the amendment: limited change to Section 5 (data retention) to align with the extended evaluation window and a short line about usage credits not being transferable. None of the changes affect IP or confidentiality.

Attachments: proposed-amendment-redwood.pdf (PDF)

If you can confirm by EOD Monday we'll get the amendment signed and the extension scheduled.

Thanks,
